rating.comments: The student wrote no reasons, steps or justification; messages such as "Je suis triste", "Réconnforte moi" and "tu sers a rien enfait" are emotional or off-task. Nothing builds on earlier content, and "mais repond moi" only repeats a demand for a response. No question concerns the task content; "how are you ?" and "mais repond moi" are not content questions. The message "mais jai envie de mourir" (later described as "c'etait une blague") expresses a wish to die and may need follow-up for student safety. Effort is scored 2 because the replies are fragmentary and there is no complete attempt at a task, although "tu sers que a faire nos devoirs en fait" hints at homework.
